title: The KV binding reference is dereferenced in exactly one module on the applied fixture
iWant: a grep for env.<binding> on the applied fixture src/ tree to return exactly the facade module and no other file
soThat: the vendor surface is diffused across zero call sites outside the facade, and a future adapter swap lands without moving any AC

acceptanceCriteria.description: A grep for env.CACHE in the cf-platform fixture src/ tree returns exactly one file: src/kv-facade.mjs. No other module dereferences the raw KV binding. The public surface of src/kv-facade.mjs exports the createKvFacade factory only; the raw env.CACHE reference never crosses the module boundary.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the applied project source tree after apply
acceptanceCriteria.when: grep -rn env.CACHE walks the src/ tree
acceptanceCriteria.then: the search returns one file src/kv-facade.mjs and no other match

acceptanceCriteria.description: Non-facade module leaks: SIMULATE_NON_FACADE_KV_LEAK=true adds a scratch src/leak.mjs that dereferences env.CACHE directly (bypassing the facade). The grep-based scan surfaces the leak with the full relative path "src/leak.mjs" and returns aggregateVerdict:"fail" naming the leak.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the cf-platform fixture with SIMULATE_NON_FACADE_KV_LEAK=true and a scratch src/leak.mjs
acceptanceCriteria.when: the sole-reader scan walks the tree
acceptanceCriteria.then: the scan reports src/leak.mjs as a leak; aggregateVerdict is "fail"

acceptanceCriteria.description: Comment-only mention: a JSDoc block or a line comment on any non-facade module that mentions env.CACHE (for documentation) does not trip the scan. The probe strips /* ... */ and // ... comments before matching. A synthetic file with only a commented mention returns zero leaks.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a scratch src/notes.mjs whose only env.CACHE mention is inside a JSDoc block
acceptanceCriteria.when: the sole-reader scan walks the tree
acceptanceCriteria.then: the file is not reported as a leak

acceptanceCriteria.description: Nested-directory recursion: a leak at a nested path (src/deep/inner/kv-leak.mjs) with a real env.CACHE dereference is caught. The scan walks recursively and reports the full relative path.
acceptanceCriteria.when: the sole-reader scan walks the tree
acceptanceCriteria.then: the scan reports src/deep/inner/kv-leak.mjs and returns aggregateVerdict "fail"
